governing_rule: Object permanence. Every intent, recurring ticket, rule set, record, person, vendor, action, control boundary, and route stays recognisable while its declared state changes. Policy state may narrow; identity, vendor provenance, role, and evidence status may not be swapped to suit a later unit.

current_observed_or_upstream_asserted: the archetypal eleven-o'clock order-status ticket is handed to a human who is not there
the vendor guide's setup skeleton and current evidence boundaries
wizard residue, solo demand, measured lift, and measured delivery hours remain unresolved
illustrative_future_only: written-consent, action-authorization, eligibility, payment, credit, delivery, signature, and acceptance templates or branches, each blocked where the engine records no faithful operation
configured, passed, live, returned, or measured states
any measured result or completed sandbox, unpaid, or paid engagement
representation_status.rule: An illustrative state describes how the proposed workflow would behave if reached. It is not evidence that Manav or any operator sold, delivered, tested, passed, charged for, or completed an engagement.

inside_engagement: checked playground results and guidance revisions
outside_engagement: the vendor's product roadmap, pricing, threshold, and counting rule
the correctness of an answer unless a person reviews it
buyer demand and willingness to pay

consent creation, action-register creation, per-action authorization, go-live eligibility opening, sandbox execution, report delivery, recommendation, signature, and paid-audit credit until the Boundary Ledger blockers are resolved
any recurring duty not separately proven and purchased

zones.description: The brand's support context: shoppers, two explicit recurring ticket examples, the configured agent, and the human team that receives handoffs.
The operator-controlled policy system: persistent intent lanes, written guidance, the never list, separate off-only action templates, checked playground results, and a closed eligibility condition.
The inspectable record: vendor baseline, tuning log, wrong-answer log, sandbox residue, and an illustrative report template. Containment and correctness stay separate.
The bounded consent, access, payment, authorization, and handback roles. Buyer, payer, and founder-authorizer do not collapse into one actor.
Things the engagement does not control: separate Gorgias and Zendesk systems, the brand's adviser, and whether the service opportunity survives its tests.

objects.material_form: A persistent order-status intent record with its examples and policy history attached.
A persistent returns-and-exchanges intent record with the brand's conditions and revision history attached.
A persistent cancellation-and-edit intent record with money consequences and policy history attached.
A one-page policy record whose entries retain the intent identity and reason for exclusion.
A dated baseline record bound to the relevant vendor report and the knowledge and handover settings found before change.
A written rule set with model draft, operator edits, error correction, and playground revision represented as distinct accountable versions.
The bundled agent as a persistent configuration record; it is not a custom-built system and no future configuration is represented as completed.
A roll-up register that points to each money-action instance without merging their authorization states.
objects.static_reason: Creating the register is blocked by DSB-006. The template preserves separate action identities without claiming a record was created.

objects.material_form: The refund action as its own authorization record.
objects.static_reason: The sourced default-off boundary is represented, but changing to authorized is blocked by DSB-006.

objects.material_form: The cancellation action as its own authorization record.
objects.static_reason: The sourced default-off boundary is represented, but changing to authorized is blocked by DSB-006.

objects.material_form: The order-edit action as its own authorization record.
objects.static_reason: The sourced default-off boundary is represented, but changing to authorized is blocked by DSB-006.

objects.material_form: A versioned six-case attempt record. A failed attempt remains visible after its rule is revised, and a later attempt receives its own checked result.
A separate eligibility condition kept closed in the state model because no current Boundary Ledger operation can open it.
objects.static_reason: A pass may be checked and pinned, but opening eligibility is a separate state change blocked by DSB-007.

objects.material_form: A persistent email route with current default handback, proposed agent-first handling, human handoff, and the sourced rollback route all legible.
The explicit archetypal 'where is my order' ticket recurring at eleven at night; it has no fabricated brand, shopper, metric, or observed outcome.
The separate archetypal broken-item refund question; it is an illustrative policy case, not a documented ticket or completed refund.
A dated two-week record of reviewed tickets and guidance changes.
A dated correctness record kept separate from either vendor's containment meter.
A written authorization to read thirty days of tickets; it is distinct from admin custody.
objects.static_reason: Creating written consent is blocked by DSB-005. The object records the requirement without instantiating permission.

objects.material_form: Scoped client-controlled admin access represented as accountable custody, never as personal possession.
An illustrative screening template listing sourced decline reasons; it does not evidence a completed screen, qualified buyer, accepted offer, or sale.
objects.static_reason: BO-013 interrupts the proposed engagement, not the screening template. No qualified or completed-screen state is represented.

objects.material_form: The not-yet-purchased engagement path as a persistent opportunity that can stop at one of three sourced no-buy conditions.
A persistent refund or automated-messaging question whose accountable destination changes without the operator answering it.
A future written record of the wizard run whose two possible results stay open until an actual sandbox test occurs.
The proposed service opportunity under four explicit tests; it begins unresolved and is not represented as an established or durable gap.
An illustrative future template listing before-and-after measures, the never list, wrong-answer log, recommendation, admin return, and founder sign-off fields.
objects.static_reason: DSB-002 and DSB-003 block report delivery, recommendation creation, signature, and acceptance. A template may be inspectable but no state may imply an engagement occurred.

objects.material_form: The founder, operations lead, or head of CX screened as economic buyer; this role is not automatically payer or signatory.
objects.static_reason: The proposed workflow screens but does not transform the economic buyer, and a buy is not represented.

objects.material_form: The brand-side payer role in proposed service and vendor-fee flows; payment status is not fused with buyer fit or founder authorization.
objects.static_reason: No current engine operation faithfully represents purchase or credit; DSB-004 keeps this as a role only.

objects.material_form: The founder role that signs each money action separately and may later sign a handback; no signature is represented as completed.
objects.static_reason: The action records may change; the human role does not. Report signature remains blocked by DSB-002.

objects.material_form: One to five support agents who inherit deliberate handoffs and remain visible as people, not removed capacity.
objects.static_reason: The offer configures handoff; it does not replace, resize, or transform the support team.

objects.material_form: Customers asking support questions, with no fabricated identity, product, metric, or outcome.
objects.static_reason: The engagement changes routing and rules, not the shopper or underlying need.

objects.material_form: One accountable practitioner who reads, decides, configures, checks, reports, and gives control back.
objects.static_reason: The operator performs operations but is not an object those operations transform.

objects.material_form: Gorgias as a separate external vendor instance carrying its own guide, wizard, plan ladder, under-$3M boundary, and per-resolution mechanism without a supported dollar amount.
objects.static_reason: The engagement configures a customer account but does not change Gorgias, its roadmap, price, or rules.

objects.material_form: Zendesk as a separate external vendor instance carrying the published $1.50 figure and 72-hour definition, never transferred to Gorgias.
objects.static_reason: The engagement configures a customer account but does not change Zendesk, its roadmap, price, or rules.

objects.material_form: The brand's own adviser outside the engagement boundary.
objects.static_reason: The question changes destination; the operator neither performs nor changes the adviser's work.

objects.material_form: A source-receipt surface for small-business AI adoption, paid-service use, planned customer-service use, and Shopify scale, with populations kept separate.
objects.static_reason: It carries upstream evidence labels and limits; the proposed engagement does not change these external observations.

objects.material_form: A source-receipt surface holding the large-company GenAI finding beside the explicit small-brand hypothesis boundary.
objects.static_reason: The evidence population is external and fixed; the world may display but never upgrade it.

objects.material_form: A source-receipt surface keeping vendor onboarding, certified agencies, specialist-shop offers, and the absence of observed solo economics distinct.
objects.static_reason: Observed adjacent operating layers do not become solo demand, price, or partner eligibility.

objects.material_form: A source-receipt surface for Klarna's much-larger-company cost-versus-quality reversal.
objects.static_reason: The example is context, not a small-brand outcome or demand signal.

objects.material_form: A transparent scenario record for fee, hours, capacity, costs, owner-compensation target, payback assumptions, and modeled buyer boundary.
objects.static_reason: The model is an upstream scenario and no implementation or sale has occurred in this world.

object_classes.class_rule: Each intent preserves its own examples, policy, and revision history. Safety may narrow after error; it may not widen without a separately sourced reauthorization operation.
Each action remains independently off in the current model. DSB-006 blocks authorization-state creation; if later resolved, authorization of one action must never authorize another by implication.
Mechanism, price, threshold, counting rule, roadmap, and evidence remain attached to the named vendor instance.
These are separate upstream archetypal examples. They recur for narrative comparison but never become fabricated customer evidence or merge into one ticket.

paths.description: The not-yet-purchased engagement stops at a sourced no-buy condition; no positive branch creates a qualified buyer or sale.

edges.condition: The vendor supplies human onboarding above the stated line.
The brand is below the approximately 1,000-ticket modeled boundary.
The founder refuses individual sign-off for money-moving actions.

paths.description: The accountable route from unclassified evidence into a policy lane, with only sourced narrowing after a wrong answer.

edges.condition: The operator judges the intent safe from audited tickets and policy.
Written conditions determine whether automation is allowed.
The intent must stay with a human or lacks required authorization.
A wrong answer occurs on a safe intent and guidance is rewritten.
A wrong answer touches a money question.

paths.description: A checked failure remains pinned, its identified guidance rule is revised separately, and only a newly checked attempt may later pin a pass. Go-live eligibility stays a separate blocked condition under DSB-007.

edges.condition: A real named case fails and BO-005 pins that checked result; this candidate shows the branch only.
A real attempt passes every named case and BO-005 pins that checked result; this candidate shows the branch only.
After BO-016 revises the identified guidance rule, a separate later attempt is checked and still fails; the earlier failed attempt remains in history.
After BO-016 revises the identified guidance rule, a separate later attempt is checked and passes; the earlier failed attempt remains in history.

paths.description: The recurring order-status example moves from current unattended handback to a separately marked illustrative ending.

edges.condition: The current default route hands the after-hours ticket to a person who is not there.
The narrative returns to a future example under a written safe rule; no real outcome is claimed.

paths.description: The separate refund example stays human under the never rule.

edges.condition: The written policy records that this refund question must not be automated; no refund outcome is claimed.

paths.description: Client-controlled access enters temporary operator custody only after consent and returns to the brand at illustrative handoff.

edges.condition: Required consent already exists and the existing scoped client-controlled access is routed into temporary operator custody; consent creation remains blocked by DSB-005.
The bounded work ends and no ongoing access remains.

paths.description: The question leaves the operator-controlled queue without the operator supplying advice.

edges.condition: A refund or automated-messaging issue touches consumer-protection rules.

paths.description: The proposed opportunity begins unresolved and stops at any narrated kill condition.

edges.condition: A recorded sandbox run shows no material human setup work remains.
Fifteen qualified conversations produce no buyer at the fee.
The unpaid implementation measures under ten points of lift.
The unpaid implementation takes more than forty-five hours.

evidence_anchors.label: observed
evidence_anchors.meaning: A government survey reports fewer than one in five US small businesses using AI and retail closer to one in seven.
evidence_anchors.attachment_note: Keep government-survey attribution, US small-business population, retail subset, and May 2026 timing attached.
evidence_anchors.must_not_imply: That most businesses use AI or that the rate measures customer-service use.

evidence_anchors.label: observed
evidence_anchors.meaning: Bank transaction research reports about 17.7 percent of 4.6 million small businesses paying for AI services by end-2025.
evidence_anchors.attachment_note: Keep the bank-transaction population and date attached; it is a separate measure from the government survey.
evidence_anchors.must_not_imply: That the transactions measure spend on setup help.

evidence_anchors.label: observed, enterprise, verified via secondary
evidence_anchors.meaning: A large-company GenAI study reports a 95 percent no-measurable-P-and-L-impact finding and a bought-versus-built difference.
evidence_anchors.attachment_note: The large-company population and the small-brand hypothesis boundary stay visible at first use.
evidence_anchors.must_not_imply: A 95 percent small-business failure rate or that the enterprise result transfers directly to the buyer.

evidence_anchors.label: observed, vendor primary
evidence_anchors.meaning: Gorgias's go-live guide names knowledge, skills, handover, playground testing, and manual ticket review as setup work.
evidence_anchors.attachment_note: This supports the workflow skeleton only and remains attached to Gorgias and the guide.
evidence_anchors.must_not_imply: That the wizard skips these steps or is inadequate; its residue is untested.

evidence_anchors.label: observed, platform listing
evidence_anchors.meaning: The time-stamped helpdesk plan ladder runs from $10 for 50 tickets to about $900 for 5,000 tickets.
evidence_anchors.attachment_note: Keep 'as of when checked' and the platform-listing context attached.
evidence_anchors.must_not_imply: Any per-agent price, the excluded $250 add-on figure, or that plan spend proves setup demand.

evidence_anchors.label: observed, vendor primary, mechanism only
evidence_anchors.meaning: Gorgias says its AI agent is on every plan and charges when it resolves a conversation.
evidence_anchors.attachment_note: The evidence establishes mechanism only and stays attached to the Gorgias instance.
evidence_anchors.must_not_imply: Any per-resolution dollar amount for Gorgias.

evidence_anchors.label: observed, vendor primary
evidence_anchors.meaning: Zendesk publishes $1.50 per automated resolution and a 72-hour quiet-period definition, announced in August 2024.
evidence_anchors.attachment_note: Keep vendor, price, definition, and announcement date attached to Zendesk only.
evidence_anchors.must_not_imply: That Gorgias charges the same amount or uses the same counting rule.

evidence_anchors.label: observed, vendor primary
evidence_anchors.meaning: The vendor directory lists certified agencies selling setup, optimization, and AI integration, and names accepted organization types.
evidence_anchors.attachment_note: This establishes an adjacent agency layer and directory program only.
evidence_anchors.must_not_imply: That solo operators are admitted or refused, any service price, or solo demand.

evidence_anchors.label: observed, vendor primary
evidence_anchors.meaning: Gorgias sells onboarding, a premium program, and professional AI Agent setup at a custom quote and publishes a sixty-day average launch time.
evidence_anchors.attachment_note: Treat the fifty-in-fifty language as vendor pitch and the services as an adjacent layer.
evidence_anchors.must_not_imply: That any brand achieves 50 percent automation or that the proposed solo practice has demand.

evidence_anchors.label: observed, vendor primary
evidence_anchors.meaning: Gorgias shipped an AI Agent onboarding wizard in October 2024.
evidence_anchors.attachment_note: Existence and release date only; the record remains untested until a real sandbox run.
evidence_anchors.must_not_imply: What the wizard leaves undone or that it is inadequate.

evidence_anchors.label: observed, self-published seller
evidence_anchors.meaning: A Gorgias partner shop publishes three implementation tiers and monthly optimization retainers with price on a call.
evidence_anchors.attachment_note: This establishes seller-published offer shape and retainer existence, not verified outcomes or a market price.
evidence_anchors.must_not_imply: Any price or the seller's greater-than-60-percent automation commitment as an outcome.

evidence_anchors.label: observed, vendor primary
evidence_anchors.meaning: Gorgias's plan guide says under-$3M brands use self-serve onboarding, $3M-to-$20M brands get one-to-one onboarding, and most brands go live within 48 hours using self-serve resources.
evidence_anchors.attachment_note: Keep vendor attribution, revenue bands, self-serve language, and vendor-claim status attached.
evidence_anchors.must_not_imply: That under-$3M brands cannot get help, that the 48-hour statement is an observed outcome, or any contract term.

evidence_anchors.label: observed, trade press
evidence_anchors.meaning: Klarna's AI handled two thirds of inquiries before its CEO later said cost had outweighed quality and the company returned to a hybrid model.
evidence_anchors.attachment_note: Keep the far-larger-than-buyer scale boundary and use the example for the trade-off only.
evidence_anchors.must_not_imply: Any Klarna number as a small-brand expectation, demand signal, or likely result.

evidence_anchors.label: observed via secondary
evidence_anchors.meaning: A small-business survey reports customer service as a planned AI use for 9 percent.
evidence_anchors.attachment_note: Keep survey attribution and the word 'planned' attached.
evidence_anchors.must_not_imply: That 9 percent currently uses AI for customer service.

evidence_anchors.label: observed, SEC filing
evidence_anchors.meaning: Shopify reports serving millions of merchants.
evidence_anchors.attachment_note: Use only as broad platform-scale context with no exact count.
evidence_anchors.must_not_imply: Any exact merchant count, Gorgias brand count, addressable market, or demand for the practice.

evidence_anchors.label: modeled
evidence_anchors.meaning: The practice scenario uses a $4,000 fee, thirty hours with a forty-five-hour stress case, two implementations per month, and modeled cost inputs.
evidence_anchors.attachment_note: Every number remains the author's transparent scenario and the no-observed-solo-fe boundary stays attached.
evidence_anchors.must_not_imply: Observed performance, an earnings forecast, or that any input is typical, conservative, realistic, reasonable, or achievable.

evidence_anchors.label: modeled
evidence_anchors.meaning: The base case does not clear a $120,000 owner-compensation target and would require more implementations than the cap or a higher fee.
evidence_anchors.attachment_note: Keep the target, arithmetic, two stated alternatives, and capacity conflict together.
evidence_anchors.must_not_imply: That either alternative is attainable or that the business automatically fails.

evidence_anchors.label: modeled with observed inputs
evidence_anchors.meaning: The buyer-payback example combines a hypothesized lift, assumed minutes and labor cost, and Zendesk's published fee.
evidence_anchors.attachment_note: Keep the lift as hypothesis, minutes and rate as guesses, and the $1.50 input attached to Zendesk.
evidence_anchors.must_not_imply: That the lift is a result, payback is typical, or the calculation applies unchanged to Gorgias.

evidence_anchors.label: modeled
evidence_anchors.meaning: The roughly 1,000-ticket minimum buyer boundary is derived from the payback assumptions.
evidence_anchors.attachment_note: Keep the modeled label and dependence on C018's assumptions attached to every use.
evidence_anchors.must_not_imply: An observed market boundary or buyer demand.

evidence_anchors.label: component capability
evidence_anchors.meaning: A general model drafts from brand materials while the operator decides every money, shipping, and cancellation rule.
evidence_anchors.attachment_note: Capability, not outcome; the human decision boundary stays attached to the rule set.
evidence_anchors.must_not_imply: That the model produces the never list, judges correctness, or owns a money-action decision.

evidence_anchors.label: observed boundary
evidence_anchors.meaning: The verified-resolution meter counts containment, not correctness.
evidence_anchors.attachment_note: The wrong-answer log remains separate because the meter cannot prove answer quality.
evidence_anchors.must_not_imply: That a rising verified-resolution rate proves good or correct answers.

evidence_anchors.label: observed risk, synthesis
evidence_anchors.meaning: The vendor can close the proposed gap because it sells setup, ships a wizard, and is paid per resolution.
evidence_anchors.attachment_note: The components are observed; the gap-closing release is only a risk condition and the current gap remains unresolved.
evidence_anchors.must_not_imply: That an auto-configuration release exists or is announced, or that a durable service gap currently exists.

evidence_anchors.label: adjacent, observed layers
evidence_anchors.meaning: The job is sold by the vendor and certified agencies while no solo operator was found at disclosed economics.
evidence_anchors.attachment_note: This establishes adjacent operating layers and the no-observed-solo boundary, not the proposed solo market.
evidence_anchors.must_not_imply: Any observed solo price or demand, or that individuals are admitted to or refused from the partner program.

failure_routes.trigger: A playground case does not pass.
failure_routes.recovery_state: the failed result remains pinned, BO-016 revises only the identified guidance rule, and a separate BO-005 check is required
failure_routes.visible_consequence: The path cannot jump from failure or revision to pass.

failure_routes.recovery_state: the one channel restores its previous configuration
failure_routes.visible_consequence: The sourced rollback remains visible but has no selected Boundary Ledger operation; DSB-001 stays open.

failure_routes.trigger: A wrong answer touches a money question.
failure_routes.recovery_state: the intent narrows to never and guidance is rewritten
failure_routes.visible_consequence: The policy may narrow only; no reverse transition exists without sourced reauthorization.

failure_routes.trigger: A refund or automated-messaging question touches consumer-protection rules.
failure_routes.visible_consequence: The question leaves the operator-controlled zone; the operator does not answer it.

money_flows.kind: proposed fixed fee entered through a paid audit credited against implementation
money_flows.trigger: A future brand purchases the bounded engagement; no purchase is evidenced here.
money_flows.rule: The $4,000 figure and payback are modeled. Payment and later credit are not represented as completed operations because DSB-004 is open.
money_flows.representation: illustrative future flow only; not a sale, invoice, payment, credit, or engagement record

money_flows.trigger: Gorgias counts a resolved conversation under its own rules.
money_flows.rule: Mechanism only. No source-confirmed Gorgias per-resolution dollar figure may appear.

money_flows.kind: $1.50 per automated resolution under Zendesk's published 72-hour definition
money_flows.trigger: Zendesk counts an automated resolution under its published definition.
money_flows.rule: Observed Zendesk input only. It cannot be transferred to Gorgias or treated as proof of buyer payback.

human_judgement_gates.decision: Does the prospective brand pass the vendor line, modeled ticket boundary, and per-action sign-off requirement?
human_judgement_gates.representation: illustrative future decision; no buyer or engagement is evidenced

branches.inside-stated-band: May proceed to an offer, subject to all other requirements; this branch creates no sale.

human_judgement_gates.decision: Is this named intent safe, conditional, or never?

branches.safe: Eligible for agent-first handling only after later gates pass.
branches.conditional: Eligible only under written conditions and handoff rules.

human_judgement_gates.decision: May this specific money-moving action be enabled?
human_judgement_gates.representation: illustrative future decision only; authorization-state creation is blocked by DSB-006 and no action has been signed or enabled

branches.would-authorize-per-action: Only this named action could be authorized after a faithful Boundary Ledger operation exists.

human_judgement_gates.decision: Does the current attempt pass every named case?
human_judgement_gates.representation: illustrative future check; no test has run or passed

branches.passed: BO-005 pins the checked pass. Opening eligibility is a separate blocked state change under DSB-007.
branches.rule-change-required: BO-005 pins the failure; BO-016 revises only the rule; a separate later BO-005 check is required.

human_judgement_gates.decision: Did a reviewed answer meet the brand's policy rather than only the vendor's resolution definition?

branches.correct: Record the review without treating containment as correctness.
branches.wrong: Log it, narrow the intent when required, and rewrite guidance; no widening path is implied.

human_judgement_gates.decision: Would a future report contain the before-and-after measures, never list, wrong-answer log, recommendation, admin return, and founder sign-off?
human_judgement_gates.representation: illustrative template review only; delivery, recommendation, signature, and acceptance operations are blocked by DSB-002 and DSB-003

branches.complete-template: The illustrative template shows the required fields but cannot become signed or delivered in this model.
branches.incomplete: Do not substitute a lift claim for a missing field.

human_judgement_gates.decision: Has any explicit company kill condition been observed?
human_judgement_gates.representation: all four conditions are unresolved at candidate time

branches.none-observed-yet: Validation stays open; this is not proof of viability.

camera_anchors.job: Keep economic buyer, payer, founder-authorizer, shoppers, support agents, and operator legible as distinct roles affected by routing and handoff.
camera_anchors.when_used: Establishment, a judgment handoff, or the illustrative ownership return.

camera_anchors.job: Read one persistent intent, action, rule version, or eligibility record without implying an unsupported reverse transition.
camera_anchors.when_used: Classification, operator correction, per-action authorization, or playground branching.

camera_anchors.job: Hold a source-bound metric or record still enough to inspect its label, vendor, population, and qualification.
camera_anchors.when_used: Baseline, source receipt, tuning record, sandbox residue, modeled arithmetic, or illustrative report template.

camera_anchors.job: Show who holds control and where it would return without making access, payment, signature, or engagement look completed.
camera_anchors.when_used: Consent, scoped admin custody, per-action authorization, and illustrative handback.

prohibited_evidence: Any legacy episode economics or visual authority.
Any automation-rate promise or vendor marketing rate used as an outcome.
Any small-business version of the enterprise 95 percent finding.
Any Gorgias per-resolution dollar amount or migration of a Zendesk fact to Gorgias.
Any claim about what the wizard leaves undone before a real sandbox residue is recorded.
Any observed solo price, demand, customer result, partner-program acceptance, or sustainable-livelihood claim.
Any future passed, paid, credited, authorized, live, returned, delivered, signed, or accepted state presented as a completed engagement.
Any implication that Manav has sold or delivered this service; upstream H004 explicitly says he has not.
Any safety widening or reversal without a separately sourced and Boundary-Ledger-bound reauthorization operation.

Any filled state for configuration rollback, report delivery, recommendation, signature, paid audit, credit, consent creation, action authorization, go-live eligibility opening, sandbox execution, or first-draft record creation while DSB-001 through DSB-009 remain open.
